info.description: QA Pilot /api/v1. Run with Newman: npx newman run postman/qa-pilot.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json --env-var password=<SEED_USER_PASSWORD>. Needs the baseline seed. Generated by postman/build_collection.py; edit that file, not this one.
